subject: Fiscaleon billing evaluation & contract timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Park <nicole.park@fiscaleon.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, michael_grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: Fiscaleon billing evaluation & contract timeline

Nicole — thanks for the demo last week. We had follow-ups from Finance and RevenueOps and want to run a short evaluation focused on three things: 1) integration surface with NetSuite and our event-based billing pipeline, 2) controls for proration/credits and revenue recognition, and 3) support SLAs for peak billing runs.

Can you confirm availability for a technical deep-dive next Wednesday (Jan 13) and share an updated product summary + draft SoW I can circulate to Finance? If you can include a rough implementation timeline (weeks) and a list of dependencies (NetSuite connector, revenue ops mapping, support contacts) that would be ideal.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Fiscaleon_product_summary.pdf
From: Nicole Park <nicole.park@fiscaleon.com>
To: ben.carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fiscaleon.com
Date: 2027-01-10T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fiscaleon billing evaluation & contract timeline

Hi Ben — great to chat. Confirming Wed Jan 13 10:00am PT for the technical deep-dive with our integrations lead. I attached the brief product summary and a first-pass SOW (see attached). High level timeline: discovery (1 wk), connector build & mapping (3-4 wks), QA & parallel run (2 wks), cutover and hypercare (1 wk). We expect NetSuite adapter work to be the longest pole.

I'll include our standard security questionnaire answers ahead of the call. If Finance wants a vendor security contact, include procurement@fiscaleon.com.

— Nicole
Nicole Park
Enterprise Partnerships, Fiscaleon
nicole.park@fiscaleon.com

Attachments: Fiscaleon_product_summary.pdf, SOW_draft_v1.docx
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, michael.grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-11T08:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fiscaleon billing evaluation & contract timeline

Thanks — quick procurement notes before the deep-dive:

- We need a pre-sales redline of the contract (we'll share Redwood terms). Please confirm whether Fiscaleon accepts our standard Data Processing Addendum and MSS language; if not, flag exceptions in advance.
- For SoW: include milestone payment schedule and an acceptance criteria section for parallel run (we require invoice parity checks for two full billing cycles).
- Please provide a list of required Redwood contacts (who will be on the implementation team) and proposed escalation chain for outages.

Ben: I'll prepare a simple procurement checklist for the call so we capture any vendor asks in real time. Marissa, can you confirm the budget envelope and any required approvals for a below-threshold purchase vs. contract needing Finance Committee review?

Laura Bennett
Director, Procurement, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, ben.carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, nicole.park <nicole.park@fiscaleon.com>
Cc: michael.grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-12T14:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fiscaleon billing evaluation & contract timeline

Laura — budget context: finance has set a soft ceiling of $340k ARR for new billing platform integrations this FY before requiring a Finance Committee review. Based on initial pricing in the SOW, Fiscaleon's implementation + year-1 fees estimate at ~$220-260k depending on connector complexity and whether we opt for premium support. Two asks for the call: 1) a line-item estimate (license, implementation, premium support) in the SoW and 2) projected run-rate cost per invoice token (or per-invoice seat) post-cutover.

Also note: we will require SOC 2 Type II evidence and an exportable audit log for all invoice-level events. Nicole — can you confirm those are available?

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of FinOps, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: michael_grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: nicole.park <nicole.park@fiscaleon.com>, ben.carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-14T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fiscaleon billing evaluation & contract timeline

Nicole — quick technical items for tomorrow's deep-dive (Jan 13 call moved to Jan 14 per calendar update):

- NetSuite: which integration pattern do you recommend (SuiteTalk SOAP, RESTlets, or CSV-based batched sync)? We need to avoid large-window batch imports during close.
- Line item mapping: how does Fiscaleon handle usage-based metering with multi-rate plans and revenue recognition mapping for ASC 606? Provide an example mapping with our event schema if possible.
- KV cache / webhook backpressure: what guarantees do you offer if Fiscaleon is slow to acknowledge invoice events? We need idempotency and retry semantics documented.

If you can drop short answers ahead of the call, I can circulate them to Eng so we have fewer deep-dive surprises.

Michael Grant
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
